title: Quarterly Financial Report Reauthorization Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the Senate on October 6, 2015. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 2) This bill extends the authority of the Department of Commerce to conduct the quarterly financial report program through September 30, 2030, under which Commerce collects and publishes quarterly financial statistics of business operations, organization, practices, management, and relation to other businesses, including data on sales, expenses, assets, liabilities, and other measures of financial condition.

(Sec. 3) Commerce must conduct and report to specified congressional committees on a review of the data security procedures of the Bureau of the Census. Such report shall:

  • identify all Bureau information systems that contain sensitive information;
  • describe any actions carried out by Commerce or the Bureau to secure sensitive information since the data breaches of Office of Personnel Management systems were announced in 2015;
  • identify any known data breaches of Bureau information systems that contain sensitive information; and
  • identify whether the Bureau stores any information that, if combined with other information, would comprise classified information.

summary.headline: This law extends the Commerce Department's quarterly business financial report program through 2030 and requires a Census Bureau data security review.
summary.what_it_does: It extends Commerce's authority to collect and publish quarterly financial statistics on businesses, such as sales, expenses, assets, and liabilities, through September 30, 2030. It also requires Commerce to review the data security procedures of the Census Bureau and report to specified congressional committees. The report must list the Bureau's systems that hold sensitive information, describe security steps taken since the 2015 Office of Personnel Management data breaches, identify any known breaches, and say whether stored data could reveal classified information when combined with other data.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that report quarterly financial data to the Commerce Department
who_it_affects.how: They may continue to be asked for quarterly information on sales, expenses, assets, and liabilities while the program runs through 2030.

who_it_affects.group: Economists, researchers, and policymakers who use business financial statistics
who_it_affects.how: The published quarterly data series can continue to be produced through 2030.

who_it_affects.group: People whose sensitive information is held by the Census Bureau
who_it_affects.how: Commerce must review how the Bureau protects sensitive data and report on any known breaches and security gaps to Congress.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Signed into law October 22, 2015; the quarterly financial report authority runs through September 30, 2030.
